firstMeeting: Well now.... I don't believe we've met before.
Name's Balin. I run the general store here in Underhill.
So your the one poking around in that mountain.
They say the dwarves that lived there misteriously disappeared.
Noone has seen or heard from them in quite some time now.
I hope you're not planning to go exploring in there.
regularDialogue: Good to see you again. Need anything from the shop today?
The mountain has been quiet for years... though sometimes I swear I still hear the old mines calling.
Take care if you're heading into the mountain. It has a way of surprising even the most experienced miners.
